title: Add and strip component parameters on document load and save
summary: Registers the SDK's DXP.NotificationHandler to react to document notifications: adds a hidden parameter to every component when a schematic loads, and removes it, re-saves and restores it when the schematic is saved.
phrasings: run code when a schematic is opened
handle the document saved event in an extension
add a hidden parameter to all components
keep a parameter out of the saved file

commands.name: EnableNotifications
commands.description: Turn the document load/save handler on or off, or show its state and the notifications it saw
commands.params: State=on|off|status (default status); with on: Name=<parameter name, default SampleParameter>, Value=<text, default SampleValue>, Under=<folder: only schematics under it>; Reset (clears the counters)

commands.name: Notification.Document
commands.description: Handle one document notification: DocumentLoading adds the parameter, DocumentSaved removes it, saves again and adds it back (called by the shim's notification handler)
commands.params: Code=<notification code> (set by the shim; the notification is the command's context)

commands.name: AddParameters
commands.description: Add the hidden sample parameter to every component of the focused schematic
commands.params: Name=<parameter name, default SampleParameter>|Value=<text, default SampleValue>

commands.name: RemoveParameters
commands.description: Remove the sample parameter from every component of the focused schematic

commands.name: CountParameters
commands.description: Count the components of the focused schematic that carry the sample parameter, and report whether the document is modified
commands.params: Name=<parameter name, default SampleParameter>|Value=<text, default SampleValue>

commands.name: SaveDocument
commands.description: Save the focused schematic: with IServerDocument.DoFileSave (raises no DocumentSaved), or with Via=process through AD's WorkSpaceManager:SaveObject, as File > Save (runs the save handler when it is on)
